story: The Fire Tailed Myzornis (Myzornis pyrrhoura) is an extraordinary bird that belongs to the Paradoxornithidae family. It is most commonly observed in Subtropical/tropical moist montane forests; bamboo thickets; and rhododendron scrub, where its behaviors contribute to the ecological dynamics of the area. Listed as Least Concern (LC) by the IUCN, this species' future depends on continued conservation action. The story of the Fire Tailed Myzornis is one of adaptation and resilience, offering valuable lessons for conservationists. This poster aims to bring the Fire Tailed Myzornis into focus, highlighting its beauty and the importance of its habitat.
